header.title: Find a class that fits you
header.text: Pick the class that suits you. Not sure which one? Send us a message and we will help.

firstClass.title: Before your first class
items: Wear clothes you can stretch in.
Tell your instructor about any injury or pregnancy.
Keep your meal light in the hour before class.

closing.title: Not sure where to start?
closing.text: Tell us about your body and your goals, and we will point you to the right class.
